snippet.title: ENCRYPTID | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Encryptid is a 90s inspired FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and battle iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

Do you like cryptids?

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4242890/Encryptid/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/autumnalknight.bsky.social
Twitter: https://x.com/autumnal_knight---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
